title: On-chain exchange flows, exchange supply, fee mania and hash ribbons (Coin Metrics community data, never used as signals before)
registered: 2026-10-19, before any Gen118 number was computed
data: data/raw/ext/coinmetrics-data/csv/{btc,eth}.csv, daily, ends 2026-05-23 (signals are 0 after the last row; HOLD effectively 2025-01..2026-05). Every value used with a 2-day publication lag

tests.O1 exchange net flow (PRIMARY): BTC, ETH: n = (FlowInExNtv - FlowOutExNtv) / SplyCur, 7-day sum, z vs trailing 365 days; z > 1.5 -> short 0.5 for 3 days; z < -1.5 -> long 0.5 for 3 days
tests.O2 exchange supply trend: BTC, ETH: e = SplyExNtv / SplyCur; position = -0.25 * sign(30-day change of e) (coins leaving exchanges -> long), daily
tests.O3 fee mania: BTC, ETH: f = FeeTotNtv * PriceUSD, 7-day mean, z vs trailing 365 days; z > 2 -> short 0.5 for 5 days
tests.O4 hash ribbons (BTC): 30-day MA of HashRate crosses back above its 60-day MA after >= 10 days below -> long BTC 0.5 for 30 days

costs: v6: Binance perp 5 bp per side + funding; bf: BrightFunded CFD costs
rule: standard crypto rule per book (as Gen116)
